Title: Repair kit
Body (HTML):
The repair kit is a two-component epoxy resin adhesive. Hardens at room temperature: accelerated hardening possible by raising the temperature.
Use: Particularly suitable for steel, but also other metals, wood, concrete, ceramics, glass and most plastics. The steel bond is resistant to, among other things, oil, gasoline, diesel and battery acid.
Processing: Best results are achieved with clean and rough surfaces. Cut off the required amount and knead for approx. 1 minute until a uniform color is achieved. Process within 2 minutes.
Initially, there does not appear to be any adhesion, but the kit should continue to be pressed on to the surface. Remove any excess material. When coating or repairing surfaces that are still wet, leak or are under water, apply pressure until adhesion begins. Smooth flat with water by hand for an even surface. Wash your hands with soap and water (or with a Turbo cleaning towelette) immediately after completing your work. Hardening commences after 5 to 10 minutes. The repaired part can be used again after as little as 60 minutes. The surfaces to be glued must be dry and free from dust and grease. Contents: 56 g.
